    # Copy each nonzero object as a rigid shape and translate it toward the 8 marker
    # along the cardinal direction indicated by its nearest marker, preserving spacing.

    markers = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    objs=[]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        col=grid[r][c]
        if col in (0,8) or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while q:
          x,y=q.pop(); cells.append((x,y))
          for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

            if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]]==col:
              seen.add(p); q.append(p)

      r0=sum(x for x,y in cells)/len(cells); c0=sum(y for x,y in cells)/len(cells)
      mr,mc=min(markers,key=lambda p:(p[0]-r0)**2+(p[1]-c0)**2)
      # Direction is the dominant displacement toward marker; shift until adjacent to marker.
      dr=1 if mr>r0 else -1 if mr<r0 else 0
      dc=1 if mc>c0 else -1 if mc<c0 else 0
      if abs(mr-r0)>=abs(mc-c0): dc=0

      nr=min(max(x+dr,0),h-1); nc=min(max(y+dc,0),w-1)
      for x,y in cells: out[min(max(x+dr,0),h-1)][min(max(y+dc,0),w-1)]=col
    for r,c in markers: out[r][c]=8
    return out
